base = int(input())
number = int(input())
digits = [0] * 50
count = 0

while True:
    count += 1
    digits[count] = number % base
    number //= base
    if number == 0:
        break

valid = True
i = 1
while i <= count:
    if digits[i] > 1:
        digits[i] += 1
        if digits[i] == base:
            j = i
            while j <= count and digits[j] >= base:
                digits[j] = 0
                j += 1
                if j > count:
                    count += 1
                digits[j] += 1
            i = j
        else:
            i += 1
        if digits[i - 1] > 1:
            valid = False
            break
    else:
        i += 1

print("YES" if valid else "NO")
